dedupe_keys.name: pipeline and grid cyber physical incident panel harmonised phmsa pipeline incidents and doe oe 417 grid disturbances v1 0

description: This panel harmonises US pipeline incident records from the Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA) and electric disturbance reports filed on DOE Form OE-417 into one table for cyber-physical infrastructure analysis. It was published on Zenodo in September 2026 (version 1.0) by Friday Ogochukwu Ikwuogu, described in the record as an independent researcher. It holds 12,935 records, 9,654 PHMSA incidents and 3,281 OE-417 reports, from 2010 onwards, with a common column structure, normalised dates, unified incident categories and system-type labels. Each record is classified with a YAML taxonomy for SCADA, telemetry, telecom and cyber involvement. The archive includes the processing pipeline, configuration, taxonomy, raw inputs, a harmonised CSV, a provenance JSON and fetch and join logs. Coverage is the United States. The data are a zipped archive of about 13 MB, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost, with the underlying federal data in the public domain. Caveats: the control-system classification is the author's own, and it is a single-author derivative of the official sources. Simulation uses are studying control-system and telecom factors in pipeline and grid incidents and cross-sector incident statistics. Related records: data-us-ccgt-operational-benchmark also builds on federal energy data.
